item.title: Opinion: Europe's summer of extreme heat
item.description: Europe faces another severe heat wave. Earlier record temperatures damaged crops, sparked wildfires, and led to more deaths...

item.title: Switzerland, a neutral nation, leads world in nuclear bunkers
item.description: After the Cold War, Switzerland continued building bomb shelters instead of dismantling them. The country now has over 370,000 nuclear bunkers...

item.title: Women's professional baseball league debuts with four teams
item.description: The Los Angeles Queens, New York Heights, Boston Hunters, and San Francisco Firebells play their first games in Springfield, Ill.

item.title: Ukraine mourns Oleksiy Yukov, who died recovering war dead
item.description: Oleksiy Yukov spent two decades recovering soldiers' bodies, including Russians. He was killed on a mission after stepping on a mine.
